findings.desc: CHK-003 userSees promises `recall --story <id>` prints a ranked top-N list, but the CLI schema in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1763-1767 only registers --storyId (not --story). Running `lattice recall --story B-7561` silently drops the flag and returns the usage message instead of results. The handler (handlers/recall.ts:136) does `args.storyId ?? args.story` but the CLI arg parser never populates args.story because the schema has no `story` field. The smoke test bypasses this by calling h.recall({storyId:...}) directly. Fix: add `story: z.string().optional()` alias in the recall schema in cli-engine.ts, or rename storyId to story to match the documented flag name.
